name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Russian chemist and professor who proposed the framework hypothesis and founded the molecular layering method.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Russian chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who co-developed the molecular layering method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Russian technical university where Aleskovskii studied and worked for much of his career.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: Russian university where Aleskovskii served as rector and professor in later career.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked after graduation.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: Soviet scientific academy where Aleskovskii was elected a corresponding member.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Molecular Layering
summary: Gas-phase layer by layer deposition technology developed by Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov.

name: Framework Hypothesis
summary: Theoretical concept proposed by Aleskovskii regarding the chemical structure of solids.

name: T. Suntola
summary: Finnish physicist who independently developed atomic layer epitaxy.
